quirks: inputSchema was null in the registry; the search text goes in the ?query= URL query param (url-encoded), not a JSON body — this endpoint is GET.
Response is large (~563KB for a broad query) — body.places[] returns many full place records with addressComponents, viewport, etc.
Some text fields come back localized (e.g. country name 'Verenigde State van Amerika' / languageCode 'af') — don't rely on address strings being English.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.auor.io/google-maps/v1/search/full with your search text url-encoded in the ?query= param (e.g. ?query=coffee%20shops%20in%20San%20Francisco). Pay $0.04 USDC via x402 on Base; no auth/sign-in needed. The response is plain sync JSON — read results from body.places[], where each place has id, name, formattedAddress, location.latitude/longitude, rating, and googleMapsUri. Expect a large payload for broad queries; narrow the query to reduce size.
